arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
test_cases = [
    '+0100',
    '-0530',
    '+1000',
    '-0830',
    '+01:00',
    '-05:30',
    '+10:00',
    '-08:30',
]

for input_tz in test_cases:
    fmt = 'a {:ti} b'
    s = 'a 1997-07-16T19:20' + input_tz + ' b'
    
    # Parse using ti format
    dt_r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    if dt_r:
        tz = dt_r.fixed[0].tzinfo
        print('Input:', repr(input_tz))
        print('  Parsed tz:', tz)
        print('  Name:', tz._name)
        print('  Offset:', tz._offset)
    print()
"
